reasons.overall: South-east is the Agni (fire) corner — ideal for the kitchen. The living zone here benefits from corrections to channel fire energy positively.

entrance.reason: The main door is most auspicious in the NE, N or E (the Ishan–Kuber arc); W and NW are workable; S, SW and SE entries are cautioned and rely on remedies.

living.reason: Living room in the NE or north draws prosperity; seating should face east or north. Keep the NE corner light and uncluttered.

masterBed.reason: Master bedroom in the SW (earth zone) promotes restful sleep and stability. Sleep with head pointing south or east.

kitchen.reason: Kitchen belongs in the SE (Agni corner); south works, NW is a fallback. NE or north kitchens set fire and water energies in conflict.

bed2.reason: Secondary bedrooms suit the west or south — stable, with afternoon light. NE is acceptable for unmarried children.

bed3.reason: Guest and children’s rooms suit the NW (Vayu zone). Children sleep with head to the south or east; avoid the SE for kids.

pooja.reason: Puja room belongs in the NE (Ishan kona) — the most sacred zone. Deity faces east or west; the devotee faces east or north.

bathroom.reason: Toilets belong in the NW or west. The NE (Ishan kona) must never host a wet area; SW toilets weaken household stability.
